title: Gemma 4 12B: A unified, encoder-free multimodal model
summary: Google announces Gemma 4 12B, a groundbreaking unified multimodal model that eliminates the traditional encoder-decoder architecture, processing text, images, audio, and video through a single transformer-based framework for improved efficiency and simplicity.
problem_solved: Simplifies multimodal AI development by removing the need for separate encoder and decoder components, enabling a single unified model to handle diverse input types efficiently.
why_valuable: Provides developers with an open-weight, production-ready multimodal model that reduces complexity while maintaining high performance across text, vision, and audio tasks.
